description:
A dock for the Gnome Shell. This extension moves the dash out of the overview transforming it in a dock for an easier launching of applications and a faster switching between windows and desktops. Side and bottom placement options are available.

Adaptive build: GNOME AppUsage-based running-app ordering aligned with the Eidrien adaptive workspace system, drop-level manual reorder locking, configurable high-speed workspace scroll timing, overview hover focus for grouped application icons, and staged app-first crowding that removes secondary dock items before shrinking application targets or scrolling.
name: Dash to Dock (Adaptive Build)
